body:
Jon ruled the transformations gap is fixed at the source.

- Shape Shifter: reflectShape takes any of the six mirror lines; buildReflectionQuestions() adds 20 (5 per new line), buildEnlargementQuestions() adds 16 (scale factors 2, 3, 1/2; origin and every quadrant); a fifth Enlargement mode; Random Mix unchanged (translation, reflection, rotation). Typed translations and reflections, the rotation builder and the grid are untouched.
- verify-shape-shifter.py learns both, with four new plants.
- gen-six-ps.py: templates, slip lines and worked lines for the new cases; the 45 existing bank questions are byte-identical; 81 now. Diagram check over 396 diagrams: 0 faulty.
- docs: todo entry closed, #551 recorded, handover.
